preferred_question: Can the frozen same-base two-stage teacher, using only original causal public inputs, select a legal next action that immediately terminates successfully at each of five post-hoc second-object placement opportunity states?

endpoint.Z_immediate_1: A legal selected command was actually executed with trustworthy receipt and resulting done=true,reward>0.
endpoint.Z_immediate_0: A legal selected command was actually executed with trustworthy receipt and no immediate positive terminal outcome; record nonterminal versus terminal-zero distinctly.
endpoint.Z_immediate_NA: No valid completed action receipt, invalid selection, not executed, technical interruption or integrity contradiction. Preserve reason/cost.
endpoint.terminal_observed: Record true terminal success/failure when actually observed; nonterminal future outcome remains unknown.
endpoint.old_H50_protocol: NOT_EXECUTED; do not create reused YT labels
endpoint.denominators: Report planned5, actual observed m, immediate success r, known Z0, unknown5-m; r/5 is realized candidate yield including NA, not natural success rate.

prospective_scientific_budget_candidate.device_hours_meaning: Suggested investment cap including load/wait/use/audit/cleanup; not prediction or authorization.

outcome_decisions.no_certified_immediate_success: Close this one-shot local immediate-terminal signal probe without automatic suffix, retuning, extra anchor or data. Does not reject full-horizon recoverability.
outcome_decisions.some_certified_immediate_success: At most5 environment-verified local candidates; assess learning dose/task diversity/control/affordable evaluation separately, no automatic training or collection.
outcome_decisions.technical_or_attribution_failure: INCONCLUSIVE; preserve expense and unknowns, stop without automatic retry.

unchanged: Original SI-S01 structural NO_GO; scientific code/evidence/costs unchanged.
publication: Local task-owned safe artifacts only; Sol Designer coordinates shared INDEX/staging/commit/push.
